author: The Current
description:
Watch Lucinda Williams talk about how she came to work with Mavis Staples
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

One of the many collaborators that Lucinda Williams and producer Ray Kennedy worked with on Williams’ latest album, “World’s Gone Wrong,” is the great Mavis Staples. In an interview with The Current’s Zach McCormick, Lucinda Williams describes how she came to work with Mavis Staples on the album.

Watch the full set here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2CB8kmcAt1o
